title: Inventory lookups hanging against the supplier API
root_cause_summary: The supplier inventory API degraded to multi-second responses; calls had no timeout, so request threads accumulated waiting on it.

required_evidence.why: the failing peer, named in the log line
the supplier_p95_ms series at onset, the step change is on the supplier side, not ours
the inflight_requests series at onset, requests piling up because the calls have no timeout

red_herrings.why_tempting: the only deploy in the window, 16 minutes before onset and unrelated
